title: User experience
body:
I configured my profile, my tasks, goals, everything, the first day was ok,
The interface offers many options, or maybe the design sounds a bit overwhelming to me but I needed a simple daily help, something that offers me a clear path but I opened the app today (my second day) and it makes me feel confused, exactly the opposite I was looking for 🤷🏼
author: FabianClac

title: Nothing else like it
body:
Ive been using it for a lil bit, but its really useful for my executive dysfunction. I love how I can just vomit out words on a journal entry and it’s will adjust to me rather than me adjusting to it. 
This is really useful and honestly life saving. Thank you to the team who created this.
author: WallyWallflower

title: Already so helpful
body: I’ve only been using this app a few days but already feel it is so much value for what it is! Super nice design and easy to navigate and actual useful tools and help
author: Kate_r8s

title: So helpful
body:
I set this up two weeks ago and it’s being SO helpful. 
When i find/catch myself spinning my wheels, I come back to Indy; which gently and simply gets me back on track ❤️
author: Phianix

title: Wonderful tool for my ADHD brain
body: I love the content and systems that Christal provides for women with ADHD! I really like the way this app works- it helps synthesis my many thoughts, feelings and goals into clear statements and actionable steps. It does this in a way that doesn’t trigger judgement or rejection sensitivity. Will keep using this!
author: Pixie.AS

title: TOTAL GAME CHANGER FOR MY ADHD BRAIN
body:
I’ve known the Shimmer team for years through conferences and the ADHD community, and I’ve been proud to beta test Indy since the very beginning - I was literally their first beta tester. As an ADHD entrepreneur, tools that actually work with how our brains function are super important to me and one of the things I love most about Indy is how intentionally the Shimmer team built it with the ADHD community. I’ve shared feedback throughout the beta, and I’ve genuinely watched so much of it get incorporated as the app has evolved incredibly quickly.

Indy is the first AI tool I’ve used that actually feels built for ADHDers. What stands out most for me is how it makes me stop and intentionally look at my near past and near future. Something I didn’t do before I had it. Again, SUPER helpful for business, the weekly reflection helps me identify the highest-leverage priority instead of reacting to everything, and the summaries at the end feel like highlighting the most important line in my journal.

Instead of telling me what I ‘should’ do, it helps me choose what will actually move the needle and end the week feeling accomplished. Plus it helps me remember what I’d achieved which I always forget 😂 I’m excited to see how it develops and will be giving it to every ADHD entrepreneur I know!
author: Ari The ADHD Entrepreneur
